hooks.command:
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version" 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown') && BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown') && RECENT=$(git log --oneline -8 2>/dev/null || echo 'no git log') && STATUS=$(git status --short 2>/dev/null || echo 'clean') && SRC_FILES=$(find src -name '*.ts' | sort 2>/dev/null | tr '
' ' ') && TEST_FILES=$(find tests -name '*.test.ts' | sort 2>/dev/null | tr '
' ' ') && CONTEXT=$(printf '## Live Codebase Snapshot

**Version:** %s
**Branch:** %s

**Recent commits:**
%s

**Working tree status:**
%s

**Source files (src/):**
%s

**Test files (tests/):**
%s

**Run tests:** npm test
**Build:** npm run build' "$VERSION" "$BRANCH" "$RECENT" "$STATUS" "$SRC_FILES" "$TEST_FILES") && jq -n --arg ctx "$CONTEXT" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$ctx}}'
